name: menu
description: The app's start: the loading screen runs to the end and gives way to the main menu over the town (New Game, Demo, and Quit); newGame goes into a game, and a second newGame replaces it with a fresh world.

steps.comment: A scenario's first command runs once loading is done.
The version from the git tags: v0.2.0, or v0.2.1-dev.5 (3b42f27) between tags.
A second newGame replaces the game with a fresh world.
